mandatoryRules: No dose, titration, potency, route, product, strain, ratio, redosing interval, or timing recommendation.
No personal safety, interaction, diagnosis, impairment, sobriety, treatment, legal, or eligibility conclusion.
Separate federal, state, tribal, territorial, and local authority; show jurisdiction, effective date, as-of date, retrieval date, and source.
Emergency, poisoning, pregnancy, youth, driving, interaction, acute mental-health, and use-disorder signals interrupt ordinary education with fixed escalation.
Do not claim improved comprehension, clinical safety, legal completeness, individualized relevance, or behavior change.
